name: Verla Groundwood and Board Mill
description: Verla is a small mill village in Jaala, Kouvola, in southern Finland, set beside a rapid on the northern Kymi River. Its red-brick and timber factory buildings, with the workers' homes clustered around them, have survived largely as they were in the 19th century. Only a few such rural pulp and board settlements remain anywhere, so a walk here shows how people lived and worked around the mill.
